note: Spec 582 S1 atmosphere presets, data only. classic is the world's own look (the values the scene and the engine sky shader carry, so applying it changes nothing); clear is daylight with a clear sky, clouds and a light haze; amber is a frozen copy of the low-sun look picked on the 2026-11-14 contact sheet. Colours are sRGB 0..1. fog.density null means 'use the view level's own density'; fog.haze is the colour the near world fades to, fog.ground_haze the (about a tenth darker) colour the far terrain fades to, so far ground never matches the sky exactly and a hole in it is measurable. sun.elev_deg null keeps the scene's own sun direction. azimuth_deg is the compass direction of the sun, 0 toward +z and 90 toward +x.
